'''RES23''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channel operating just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. One of its broadcasts was ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]''.
